name: Saliency-mask + targeted PGD
tagline: Per-image: pick the top-k saliency pixels for each of the 8 most-likely targets, set them to the gradient sign, then refine with masked Adam PGD on (target − true) margin.

key_hyperparams.name: Adam lr
key_hyperparams.role: PGD step size on masked δ

key_hyperparams.name: loss
key_hyperparams.role: targeted margin minus weighted untargeted CE

init_recovers: Pure JSMA-style sign perturbation if PGD never accepts
diff_from_baseline: Goes beyond JSMA by combining noise-perturbed saliency masks across 8 targets with a 50-step Adam PGD refinement under a fixed L0 mask.

name: Gradient-saliency sparse + iterative refine
tagline: Greedy saliency-ranked pixel selection with five color heuristics (0/1/grad-extreme/sign/random), then six rounds of recompute-saliency add-or-swap refinement.

key_hyperparams.name: swap count
key_hyperparams.role: max simultaneous pixel swaps per round

init_recovers: JSMA-style most-salient pixel + extreme color when phase 2 is skipped
diff_from_baseline: Adds (i) explicit color search (0/1/sign/random) per saliency-ranked pixel set, (ii) iterative gradient recomputation and pixel add/swap refinement under the L0 budget — none of which appears in JSMA/SparseFool/OnePixel.

name: Multi-restart greedy gradient-PGD
tagline: Greedy support growth: at each step pick the unselected pixel with the largest expected logit change, then 7 PGD inner steps; restart with 9 different target classes plus an untargeted run, finishing with a 40-step decaying-α PGD on the final mask.
init_recovers: JSMA-style targeted greedy when PGD inner steps and final refinement are 0
diff_from_baseline: Adds multi-target restarts and a long final masked PGD on top of greedy gradient-saliency pixel addition; selects each new pixel by an explicit expected-logit-change criterion rather than by raw saliency.

name: Multi-target greedy + candidate eval + swap
tagline: Per chunk: for each of the top-3-4 target classes, greedily grow the L0 support by exact forward-evaluation of the top-6 saliency-gain candidates, then run 2 swap rounds that try to exchange weak selected pixels for stronger ones.
init_recovers: JSMA-style targeted greedy when candidate count = 1 and swap rounds = 0
diff_from_baseline: Differs from JSMA by (i) evaluating multiple candidate pixels per step via exact forwards, (ii) running multi-target restarts, and (iii) post-hoc support swap based on per-pixel saliency.

name: Greedy saliency + per-pixel color search
tagline: Add one pixel per iteration (highest |gradient| of the untargeted margin), then exhaustively search 0/1/sign/per-channel optimal color for that pixel via direct forward evaluation.
init_recovers: JSMA-style saliency picking with sign assignment when other strategies don't beat it
diff_from_baseline: Adds an exhaustive per-pixel value search (5 patterns + per-channel optimal) on top of JSMA-style saliency-driven pixel addition; no swap or multi-target restart.
